type: aType number: aNumber

	^(self subclassFor: aType) number: aNumber

number: aNumber

	self assertIsValid: aNumber.

	^self new initializeNumber: aNumber

subclassFor: aType

	^self subclasses
		detect: [ :anIdentificationClass | anIdentificationClass isFor: aType ]
		ifNone: [ self error: self invalidTypeErrorDescription ]

assertIsValid: aNumber

	(self isValid: aNumber) ifFalse: [ self error: self invalidNumberErrorDescription ]

isValid: aNumber

	^aNumber isAllDigits and: [ aNumber asNumber between: 1 and: 99999999 ]

isValid: aNumber

	^(self hasValidSize: aNumber)
		and: [ (self hasDashesAtSeparatorPositions: aNumber)
		and: [ (self hasValidHeader: aNumber)
		and: [ self hasDigitsAfterHeader: aNumber ]]]

hasDashesAtSeparatorPositions: aNumber

	^aNumber third = $- and: [ aNumber penultimate = $- ]

hasDigitsAfterHeader: aNumber

	^(aNumber copyFrom: 4 to: aNumber size - 2) isAllDigits and: [ aNumber last isDigit ]

from: aText

	^(self subclassFor: aText) code: aText

code: aText

	self assertIsValid: aText.

	^self new initializeCode: aText

subclassFor: aText

	^self subclasses
		detect: [ :aZipCodeClass | aZipCodeClass canRepresent: aText ]
		ifNone: [ self error: self invalidTypeErrorDescription ]

assertIsValid: aText

	(self isValid: aText) ifFalse: [ self error: self invalidCodeErrorDescription ]

isValid: aText

	^aText isAllDigits and: [ aText asNumber between: 1000 and: 9999 ]

isValid: aText

	^aText size = 8
		and: [ (self hasOldZipCodeInside: aText)
		and: [ (aText last: 3) isAllLetters ]]

firstName: aFirstName lastName: aLastName identification: anIdentification

	^self new initializeFirstName: aFirstName lastName: aLastName identification: anIdentification

initializeFirstName: aFirstName lastName: aLastName identification: anIdentification

	firstName := aFirstName.
	lastName := aLastName.
	identification := anIdentification.
	addresses := OrderedCollection new

streetName: aStreetName number: aStreetNumber town: aTown zipCode: aZipCode province: aProvince

	^self new
		initializeStreetName: aStreetName
		number: aStreetNumber
		town: aTown
		zipCode: aZipCode
		province: aProvince

initializeStreetName: aStreetName number: aStreetNumber town: aTown zipCode: aZipCode province: aProvince

	streetName := aStreetName.
	streetNumber := aStreetNumber.
	town := aTown.
	zipCode := aZipCode.
	province := aProvince

importCustomer

	self assertValidCustomerRecord.

	newCustomer := Customer
		firstName: record second
		lastName: record third
		identification: (Identification type: record fourth number: record fifth).

	system add: newCustomer

importAddress

	self assertCustomerWasImported.
	self assertValidAddressRecord.

	newCustomer addAddress: (Address
		streetName: record second
		number: record third asNumber
		town: record fourth
		zipCode: (ZipCode from: record fifth)
		province: record sixth)
